# ECN-2026-003 Change notice - Hot Forge CNC turning center #2

Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P1, line: P1-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L1-CN02

Reason for change
- Standardize and document the approved lubricant for EQ-P1-L1-CN02 to eliminate cross-contamination and reduce variability in spindle and tailstock performance.
- Update maintenance references and task cards to reflect the approved part for procurement and stores issuance.

Affected items
- Hot Forge CNC turning center #2, equipment tag: EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
- Maintenance material master and inventory records referencing lubricant part numbers for line P1-L1.
- Work instructions and PM task cards that currently lack a specified approved lubricant.

Implementation
- Approved lubricant part number for EQ-P1-L1-CN02 is CFW-LUB-508. Use CFW-LUB-508 for all replenishment, top-up, and change-out activities on EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
- Update the following documents to reflect CFW-LUB-508 as the specified lubricant:
  - MM-P1-L1-CN02
  - SOP-P1-L1-02
  - SOP-P1-L1-04
- Maintenance will update the equipment lubrication entry in the CMMS to list CFW-LUB-508 as the sole approved lubricant for EQ-P1-L1-CN02. Stores will flag stock and procurement with CFW-LUB-508 for EQ-P1-L1-CN02 use only.
- Technicians performing tasks on EQ-P1-L1-CN02 shall reference updated SOPs prior to execution. Any existing containers not labeled CFW-LUB-508 shall be quarantined and processed through stores per MM-P1-L1-CN02.

Approvals
- Engineering review completed; issuance pending formal sign-off. Approving signatures shall be recorded in the ECN log entry for ECN-2026-003 Rev E.
- Post-approval, distribution: update MM-P1-L1-CN02, SOP-P1-L1-02, SOP-P1-L1-04 and notify maintenance leads and stores to implement CFW-LUB-508 for EQ-P1-L1-CN02.
